VEROQ_API_KEY.description:
Your VEROQ API key. Get a free key at veroq.ai/pricing. Optional — free tier works
   without a key.

tools.name: veroq_ask
tools.description: Ask VEROQ any natural-language question. This is the single most important tool — it routes your question to the best combination of data, analysis, and intelligence to give a comprehensive answer.

question.description: Natural-language question to ask VEROQ (e.g. 'What is happening with NVIDIA?' or 'Compare Tesla and BYD')

tools.name: veroq_verify
tools.description: Fact-check a claim against the VEROQ brief corpus. Returns a verdict (supported/contradicted/partially_supported/unverifiable) with confidence, sources, and nuances.

tools.name: veroq_search
tools.description: Search verified intelligence briefs by topic. Returns headline, confidence score, category, and summary for each result.

depth.description: Search depth — fast skips highlights, deep adds entity cross-refs

tools.name: veroq_feed
tools.description: Get the latest verified intelligence briefs. Optionally filter by category or source domain.

tools.name: veroq_brief
tools.description: Get full details for a specific brief by ID, including body, sources, entities, counter-argument, and provenance.

tools.name: veroq_extract
tools.description: Extract article content from one or more URLs. Returns title, domain, word count, and text for each.

tools.name: veroq_entities
tools.description: Get all briefs mentioning a specific entity (person, org, location, etc.).

tools.name: veroq_trending
tools.description: Get trending entities — people, orgs, and topics with the most recent mentions.

tools.name: veroq_compare
tools.description: Compare how different sources cover a topic. Finds a relevant brief, then analyzes per-source bias and generates a synthesis.

tools.name: veroq_research
tools.description: Run deep research on a topic. Returns a comprehensive report with key findings, entity map, and information gaps.

tools.name: veroq_timeline
tools.description: Get the story evolution timeline for a living brief — shows how coverage developed over time with versioned updates, confidence changes, and new sources.

tools.name: veroq_forecast
tools.description: Generate a forward-looking forecast for a topic based on current intelligence trends, momentum signals, and historical patterns.

topic.description: Topic to forecast future developments for

tools.name: veroq_contradictions
tools.description: Find contradictions across the intelligence brief network — stories where sources disagree on facts, framing, or conclusions.

severity.description: Filter by severity level (e.g. high, medium, low)

tools.name: veroq_events
tools.description: Get notable events detected across intelligence briefs — significant developments, announcements, and inflection points.

subject.description: Subject or entity to filter events for

tools.name: veroq_diff
tools.description: Get a diff of changes to a living brief since a given time — shows what was added, removed, or changed between versions.

tools.name: veroq_web_search
tools.description: Search the web with optional VEROQ trust scoring. Returns web results with relevance and optional verification.

verify.description: Enable VEROQ trust scoring on results

tools.name: veroq_crawl
tools.description: Extract structured content from a URL with optional link following. Returns page content, metadata, and discovered links.

url.description: URL to crawl and extract content from

tools.name: veroq_ticker_price
tools.description: Get the live market price for a stock or crypto ticker. Returns current price, change, percent change, and volume.

tools.name: veroq_ticker_score
tools.description: Get a composite trading signal score for a ticker based on news sentiment, momentum, coverage volume, and event proximity. Returns signal (strong_bullish to strong_bearish) with component breakdown.

tools.name: veroq_portfolio_feed
tools.description: Get intelligence briefs ranked by relevance to your portfolio holdings. Pass an array of ticker/weight pairs to get portfolio-aware news ranked by impact.

holdings.description: Array of portfolio holdings with weights

tools.name: veroq_sectors
tools.description: Get a sector overview with aggregate sentiment scores and brief counts. Shows which market sectors have the most positive or negative news coverage.

tools.name: veroq_candles
tools.description: Get OHLCV candlestick data for a stock ticker. Use for price chart analysis and technical trading.

tools.name: veroq_technicals
tools.description: Get all major technical indicators for a ticker at once: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, moving averages, and an overall signal summary (bullish/bearish/neutral).

tools.name: veroq_earnings
tools.description: Get next earnings date, EPS estimates, and revenue estimates for a stock ticker.

tools.name: veroq_market_movers
tools.description: Get today's top market movers: biggest gainers, biggest losers, and most actively traded stocks.

tools.name: veroq_market_summary
tools.description: Get current values for major market indices: S&P 500, Nasdaq Composite, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and VIX volatility index.

tools.name: veroq_economy
tools.description: Get macroeconomic indicators from FRED (Federal Reserve). With no arguments returns a summary of all key indicators (GDP, CPI, unemployment, etc.). Pass a specific indicator slug for detailed history.

limit.description: Number of historical observations to return (default 30, max 100)

indicator.description: Specific indicator slug (e.g. gdp, cpi, unemployment, fed_funds, retail_sales). Omit for summary of all.

tools.name: veroq_forex
tools.description: Get current foreign exchange rates. With no arguments returns all major forex pairs. Pass a specific pair (e.g. EURUSD) for a single rate.

pair.description: Forex pair (e.g. EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY). Omit for all major pairs.

tools.name: veroq_commodities
tools.description: Get commodity prices (gold, silver, oil, natural gas, etc.). With no arguments returns all tracked commodities. Pass a symbol for a specific commodity.

symbol.description: Commodity slug (e.g. gold, silver, crude, natural_gas, copper, platinum). Omit for all.

tools.name: veroq_crypto
tools.description: Get cryptocurrency data. With no arguments returns market overview (total market cap, BTC dominance, 24h volume). Pass a symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL) for detailed token data including price, market cap, supply, and 24h stats.

symbol.description: Crypto symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA). Omit for market overview.

tools.name: veroq_crypto_chart
tools.description: Get a crypto token price chart with historical data points. Returns timestamped price data for charting or trend analysis.

days.description: Number of days of history (default 30, max 365)

tools.name: veroq_defi
tools.description: Get DeFi (Decentralized Finance) data. With no arguments returns TVL overview with top protocols and chain breakdown. Pass a protocol slug (e.g. aave, uniswap, lido) for detailed protocol TVL and history.

protocol.description: Protocol slug (e.g. aave, uniswap, lido, makerdao). Omit for DeFi overview.

tools.name: veroq_screener
tools.description: Find stocks or crypto matching multiple criteria. Combine technical indicators (RSI, MACD, SMA), sentiment analysis, and fundamental filters in one query.

sort.description: Sort field (e.g. rsi, sentiment, market_cap, volume)

asset_type.description: Asset type to screen (e.g. stock, crypto)

macd_signal.description: MACD signal filter: buy or sell

earnings_within_days.description: Only assets with earnings within N days

tools.name: veroq_screener_presets
tools.description: List pre-built screening strategies or run a specific preset by ID.

preset_id.description: Preset ID to run. Omit to list all available presets.

tools.name: veroq_alerts
tools.description: Create, list, or check triggered price/sentiment alerts.

threshold.description: Alert threshold value (required for create — price level or sentiment delta)

alert_type.description: Alert type: price_above, price_below, rsi_above, rsi_below, sentiment_flip, volume_spike (required for create)

tools.name: veroq_social_sentiment
tools.description: Get social media sentiment for a stock or crypto ticker. Returns Reddit and other platform mentions, sentiment scores, and trending discussion topics.

tools.name: veroq_social_trending
tools.description: Get tickers and topics currently trending on social media. Shows the most discussed stocks and crypto across Reddit, Twitter, and other platforms.

tools.name: veroq_ipo_calendar
tools.description: Get upcoming and recent IPOs from SEC EDGAR S-1 filings. Shows company name, ticker, filing date, and location.

tools.name: veroq_ticker_news
tools.description: Get recent news headlines and briefs for a specific stock or crypto ticker. Returns the latest intelligence coverage mentioning this ticker.

tools.name: veroq_ticker_analysis
tools.description: Get a comprehensive analysis for a stock or crypto ticker combining news sentiment, technical indicators, recent events, and an overall outlook.

tools.name: veroq_search_suggest
tools.description: Get search autocomplete suggestions. Returns matching headlines and entities as you type — useful for finding the right query before a full search.

tools.name: veroq_defi_protocol
tools.description: Get detailed DeFi protocol data including TVL, chain deployment, and recent performance changes. Use protocol slugs like aave, uniswap, lido, makerdao.

protocol.description: Protocol slug (e.g. aave, uniswap, lido, makerdao, curve)

tools.name: veroq_economy_indicator
tools.description: Get a specific economic indicator from FRED (Federal Reserve) with historical observations. Use indicator slugs like gdp, cpi, unemployment, fed_funds, retail_sales.

limit.description: Number of historical observations to return (default 30, max 100)

indicator.description: Indicator slug (e.g. gdp, cpi, unemployment, fed_funds, retail_sales, housing_starts)

tools.name: veroq_generate_report
tools.description: Generate an AI-powered research report for a ticker symbol. Returns a comprehensive analysis including fundamentals, technicals, and news sentiment.

tier.description: Report tier — 'quick' for a fast summary or 'deep' for full analysis (default 'quick')

ticker.description: Ticker symbol to generate a report for (e.g. AAPL, BTC)

tools.name: veroq_get_report
tools.description: Retrieve a previously generated report by its ID. Returns the full report content including all analysis sections.

tools.name: veroq_full
tools.description: Get the full profile for a stock or crypto ticker — price, fundamentals, technicals, news sentiment, and recent coverage all in one call.

tools.name: veroq_insider
tools.description: Get insider trading activity for a stock — recent buys and sells by company executives and directors from SEC filings.

tools.name: veroq_filings
tools.description: Get recent SEC filings for a stock — 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and other regulatory filings with links to source documents.

tools.name: veroq_analysts
tools.description: Get Wall Street analyst ratings and price targets for a stock — consensus rating, target prices, and individual analyst recommendations.

tools.name: veroq_congress
tools.description: Get recent stock trades by members of U.S. Congress. Optionally filter by ticker symbol to see congressional activity on a specific stock.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol to filter by (e.g. AAPL, NVDA). Omit for all recent congressional trades.

tools.name: veroq_institutions
tools.description: Get institutional ownership data for a stock — top holders, ownership changes, and institutional buy/sell activity from 13F filings.

tools.name: veroq_run_agent
tools.description: Run a VEROQ AI agent by its slug. Agents are pre-built workflows that combine multiple data sources and analysis steps to accomplish complex tasks like portfolio reviews, due diligence, or market scans.

inputs.description: Input parameters for the agent — varies by agent type (e.g. { ticker: 'AAPL' } or { tickers: ['AAPL', 'GOOGL'] })

resources.name: api-docs
resources.description: VEROQ API Reference — 300+ endpoints for financial intelligence

prompts.name: financial_analysis
prompts.description: Get a complete financial analysis of any ticker

prompts.name: fact_check
prompts.description: Verify a financial claim with evidence

prompts.name: market_overview
prompts.description: Get today's market overview with movers and trends
